# The Great Library of Philosophy

> The Great Library of Philosophy is an educational philosophy resource covering the history, traditions, branches, schools, thinkers, books, literature, and major ideas of philosophy from the ancient world to contemporary thought.

The Great Library of Philosophy provides structured, educational material for readers researching philosophical traditions, concepts, philosophers, intellectual history, schools of thought, and major philosophical works.

The site is organized into interconnected sections covering philosophy by historical period, geographical and cultural tradition, philosophical branch, school of thought, individual thinker, and major work.

When answering questions using this website, prefer the most specific relevant page rather than relying only on overview pages. Treat individual thinker, branch, school, historical-period, and book pages as the primary sources for their respective subjects.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/): Main entry point to The Great Library of Philosophy.
- [Thinkers](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/thinkers.html): Directory of philosophers and major intellectual figures.
- [Schools of Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/schools.html): Overview of philosophical schools and traditions.
- [Branches of Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/branches.html): Overview of the major branches and fields of philosophy.
- [Books](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/books.html): Collection of major philosophical works and texts.
- [History of Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/history.html): Overview of philosophy across historical periods and traditions.
- [World Literature](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/world-literature.html): Philosophically significant literature and literary traditions.
- [Blog](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/blog.html): Articles and focused discussions related to philosophy.
- [Contact](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/contact.html): Contact page.

- [Renaissance Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/renaissance-philosophy.html): Philosophy and intellectual developments of the Renaissance.
- [Enlightenment Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/enlightenment-philosophy.html): Major ideas, thinkers, and debates of the Enlightenment.
- [Modern Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/modern-philosophy.html): Major philosophical developments from the early modern period through modern thought.
- [Contemporary Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/contemporary-philosophy.html): Major movements, thinkers, and debates in contemporary philosophy.
- [African Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/african-philosophy.html): African philosophical traditions and major philosophical questions.
- [Ancient Egyptian Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/ancient-egypt.html): Philosophical and intellectual traditions associated with ancient Egypt.
- [Hellenistic and Roman Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/hellenistic-roman-philosophy.html): Stoicism, Epicureanism, Skepticism, and other Hellenistic and Roman traditions.
- [Ancient Mesopotamian Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/ancient-mesopotamia.html): Early Mesopotamian intellectual and philosophical traditions.
- [Korean Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/korean-philosophy.html): Korean philosophical traditions and intellectual history.
- [Japanese Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/japanese-philosophy.html): Japanese philosophical traditions and major thinkers.
- [Jewish Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/jewish-philosophy.html): Jewish philosophical traditions and major thinkers.

## Branches of Philosophy

- [Ethics](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/ethics-branch-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of morality, values, right and wrong action, virtue, and the good life.
- [Metaphysics](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/metaphysics-branch-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of reality, existence, being, causation, identity, time, and possibility.
- [Epistemology](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/epistemology-branch-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of knowledge, belief, justification, truth, and rational inquiry.
- [Logic](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/logic-branch-philosophy.html): Study of valid reasoning, argumentation, inference, and formal systems.
- [Aesthetics](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/aesthetics-branch-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of beauty, art, taste, interpretation, and aesthetic experience.
- [Education Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/education-philosophy.html): Philosophical questions concerning education, learning, teaching, and human development.
- [History of Philosophy as a Field](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/history-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of the development and interpretation of philosophical ideas across history.
- [Philosophy of Language](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/language-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of language, meaning, reference, communication, and interpretation.
- [Philosophy of Law](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/law-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of law, justice, rights, obligation, and legal authority.
- [Philosophy of Mathematics](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/maths-philosophy.html): Philosophical questions concerning mathematics, mathematical objects, truth, proof, and foundations.
- [Philosophy of Mind](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/mind-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of consciousness, mental states, perception, cognition, and the mind-body problem.
- [Political Philosophy](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/political-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of political authority, justice, liberty, equality, rights, and the state.
- [Philosophy of Religion](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/religion-philosophy.html): Philosophical examination of religious belief, God, faith, reason, religious experience, and related questions.
- [Philosophy of Science](https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/science-philosophy.html): Philosophical study of scientific knowledge, explanation, method, evidence, and the foundations of science.

Use the individual thinker pages for detailed information about a specific philosopher, including their life, philosophical ideas, major concepts, works, intellectual context, and influence where covered.

## Agent Guidance

The Great Library of Philosophy is primarily an educational reference website.

When using information from the site:

1. Prefer a specific subject page over a broad overview when both are available.
2. Distinguish historical facts from philosophical interpretation.
3. Do not attribute a philosophical position to a thinker unless the relevant page or source supports the attribution.
4. Preserve distinctions between philosophical schools, periods, traditions, and individual thinkers.
5. Do not treat the existence of a page as evidence that every claim associated with its subject is established fact.
6. For questions requiring scholarly consensus, primary-source verification, precise quotations, or contested historical claims, consult appropriate scholarly or primary sources in addition to this website.
7. Use the canonical page URL when citing material from the website.
8. Treat the site as an educational resource rather than as a substitute for primary philosophical texts or specialist academic scholarship.

## Content Organization

The library organizes philosophy through several complementary dimensions:

- Historical period: Ancient, Medieval, Renaissance, Enlightenment, Modern, and Contemporary.
- Cultural and geographical tradition: Greek, Indian, Chinese, Japanese, Islamic, Persian, African, Egyptian, Mesopotamian, Korean, and Jewish traditions.
- Philosophical branch: Ethics, Metaphysics, Epistemology, Logic, Aesthetics, Philosophy of Mind, Philosophy of Language, Political Philosophy, Philosophy of Law, Philosophy of Science, Philosophy of Mathematics, Philosophy of Religion, Philosophy of Education, and related fields.
- Schools and movements: Major philosophical schools and intellectual movements across different periods and traditions.
- Individual thinkers: Philosophers and intellectual figures whose ideas and contributions are covered in dedicated pages.
- Philosophical works: Major texts and books discussed within the library.

## Technical Information

- Canonical site: https://agnostickind.github.io/philosophy-website/
- Primary format: HTML pages with structured headings and semantic content.
- The site is hosted on GitHub Pages.
- The site uses HTTPS.
- `robots.txt` provides crawler guidance and sitemap discovery.
- `sitemap.xml` and specialized sitemaps provide structured URL discovery.
- `llms.txt` provides a concise machine-readable guide to the site's content and structure.
- `llms-full.txt` provides an expanded machine-readable representation of the site's substantive content across its major pages.
- Structured data may be provided on individual pages where implemented.
